lexis 0.1.0
  • Reference

Get GloVe embedding vector(s) for one or more words

Source: R/embeddings.R
lex_embed.Rd

Returns a matrix of 300-dimensional GloVe embeddings for the requested words. Words not present in the selected GloVe matrix are silently dropped (check the row names of the result to see which words were found).

lex_embed(words, model = c("2024", "2014"))

Arguments

words

character vector. One or more words (case-insensitive).

model

character. Which GloVe release to use: "2024" (default) or "2014".

Value

A numeric matrix with one row per found word and 300 columns. Row names are the matched word forms. Returns NULL with a warning if no words are found.

Examples

lex_embed("dog")
#>            V1       V2      V3        V4       V5       V6       V7       V8
